collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — LUCK, OMENS AND LAVASTONES (LO-01 to LO-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager who always sleeps wonderfully finds a glowing lavastone under the floor, beneath the mat.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: For as long as (name1) has lived in (his/her) hut, (he/she) has slept wonderfully. Deep, peaceful sleep every night, no matter what. (He/She) always thought (he/she) was just a good sleeper. Today, fixing a loose floorboard, (he/she) finds a small lavastone tucked underneath, right beneath where (his/her) sleeping mat lies, glowing softly in the dark.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (name1) puts the board back exactly as it was. That night, (he/she) lies awake for the first time in years, thinking about the stone. Then, eventually, (he/she) sleeps, as deeply as ever. (He/She) never tells anyone, and never looks under that board again. Some things are better left exactly where they are.

b__fx.name: Answer B
b__fx.text: (name1) moves the stone to a shelf across the room. That night, (he/she) sleeps badly. The next night, worse. (He/She) puts it back under the floor. (He/She) sleeps like a baby. (name1) isn't sure what (he/she) feels about having been helped all these years without knowing it. Grateful, mostly. A tiny bit cheated.
